text_en: In the top 20 list of net capital inflows on September 30, broad-based products took 6 spots, sector-themed products had 5 products on the list, and cross-border, commodity and strategy styles each had 1 product on the list. Among broad-based products, 2 products in the STAR 50 direction made the list: ChinaAMC STAR 50 ETF (588000) saw net inflows of 2.743 billion yuan, with scale of 94.131 billion yuan, ranking second on the net inflow list; E Fund STAR 50 ETF (588080) saw net inflows of 859 million yuan, with scale of 42.504 billion yuan, for combined net inflows of about 3.602 billion yuan.
